messages:
marta: Heads-up — we've been seeing a concentrated spike of XID/ECC errors from rack-F4 over the last 36h. Patterns point to cards with serial prefix 'APZ-9'.

kai: Yep, telemetry matches. Temp/rise on GPUs at ~68->82C just before the XIDs. Attached a short capture from node gpu-f4-03: 
```
[ 1024.345678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=4123, GPU=3
[ 1024.345689] gpu: thermal event: power limit exceeded
[ 1024.346000] ECC error: single-bit at addr 0x7fff...
```

raj: I pinged supplier. They acknowledged one lot (APZ-9*) had a QA slip and small early-failure cohort in that manufacturing window. They're prepping RMA options but lead time might be 2–3 weeks.

lia: We should assume some will fail in-field. Recommend we: 1) tag affected cards 2) create a quarantine pool 3) roll a canary drain to verify repro and collect full logs. Prefer to avoid a broad mass-drain during peak traffic.

marta: Agreed. Proposing an initial containment play:
- Tag assets with tag=hotspot-batch-APZ9 in CMDB
- Cordon nodes in rack-F4 that have APZ-9 cards
- Migrate non-critical workloads off 8 GPUs (nodes gpu-f4-03..10) during low-traffic window (02:00-06:00 UTC)
- Run memtest86 + power-cycle + extended nvmesh stress (4h)

lia: Here's the drain commands I'm planning to run (will run in canary waves of 2 nodes):
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-f4-03
kubectl drain gpu-f4-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=60s
# run memtest via ad-hoc job
kubectl apply -f memtest-job.yaml
```

ops-bot: ticket D-2347 created for "APZ-9 hotspot containment" by lia. SLA: 72h.

kai: Also adjusting our GPU health monitor thresholds temporarily to capture pre-XID telemetry: increase thermal sampling to 5s and capture last 60s of perf counters on thermal triggers. Patch to telem-agent will roll in 10m.

marta: Cost tradeoff note: If we RMA 32 GPUs, replacement + expedited shipping ~= $92k, plus ~4% capacity impact during rollout (we can use burst capacity in us-west to absorb). If we wait for supplier slower RMA, risk more in-field failures and repeated drains.

raj: Suggest we keep 16 cold spares on-site and start RMA for the rest. Ops should start procurement for replacements with 24–48h shipping. We can negotiate partial credit from supplier.

lia: For transparency, I'll publish a short runbook in #eng-infra pinned messages: containment steps, logs to collect, who to call at supplier. Will also add a checklist for on-call to escalate to hw-ops.

marta: After canary completes, we should decide: replace vs keep with firmware/workaround. If memtest/stress repros > 30% within 4h run on a node, auto-schedule replacement.

kai: Note on workaround: a soft-power-cycle + nvml reset reduces XIDs for some, but that's a band-aid — not acceptable for dedicated customer nodes. We'll document it as temporary mitigation only.

deploy-bot: Can confirm canary migration plan does not overlap with any critical deployments in the 02:00-06:00 UTC window.

marta: Next steps for action owners:
- lia: execute canary drains in waves of 2 nodes, collect logs and memtest results (owner: lia)
- kai: push telem-agent sampling bump and ensure perf dumps captured (owner: kai)
- raj: start RMA/emergency procurement conversation and confirm spare shipping (owner: raj)
- marta: tag assets in CMDB and create fleet query to find APZ-9 across regions (owner: marta)

lia: I'll start wave 1 in 40m and update thread with job links + logs. If we see repro on >1 node in wave 1, we'll escalate to immediate broader drain.

marta: Thanks. Adding follow-up review meeting in 4h to decide replacement schedule if RMA delays persist.

kai: One last note — let's ensure we capture nvprof and ECC counters as part of the memtest job. Add this snippet to memtest-job.yaml: 
```yaml
containers:
- name: memtest
  image: redwood/memtest:stable
  command: ["/run_memtest.sh", "--collect-ecc", "--nvprof"]
```

lia: copied. Starting wave 1 now. Will drop logs to the ticket and ping here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: D-2347 updated: wave1 complete for gpu-f4-03/gpu-f4-04 — memtest passed on gpu-f4-03, gpu-f4-04 failed ECC sweep at 2h.

marta: gpu-f4-04 confirmed fail — marking for immediate replacement and moving workloads to burst capacity. I'm flagging 1 more node (gpu-f4-07) as high-risk pending results.

lia: Getting vendor RMA reference number now. If vendor can prioritize, we'll do batch pickup. If not, we'll swap with cold spares and enqueue return shipping.

raj: I'll push for credit and expedited lane. Also prepping an incident summary for the postmortem: timeline, affected serial prefixes, telemetry snapshots, cost estimate.

marta: Good. Closing loop: we'll reconvene after wave 3 or earlier if failure rate crosses 1% of APZ-9 in fleet. Thanks all.
